title: Inaccurate token count
body:
### What happened? I tried to use Gemini CLI with the flash image preview model (which didnt work). However, when I closed the app, I noticed it said that I had used tokens: ### What did you expect to happen? I would expect 0 billed / used tokens. ### Client information

linked_prs.title: fix(token-usage): fix token usage recording for failed API calls
linked_prs.body: ## TLDR Fixes issue where Google OAuth users saw incorrect token usage for failed API calls. This was tested using the gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview model which does not work in gemini-cli, however, it still reported token usage despite the API error. This PR fixes this by recording token usage metrics for successful API calls, not failed ones. ## Reviewer Test Plan 1. Run current tip of main to expose the problem: 2.
